description: Inkling 2 Mini (DFlash2 drafter, k=7) release-tier profile. No service unit in the gpu-window helper is needed: inside its own window the leg stops the prod unit, starts the release-arm container on :8001 (accept.py inkling_docker_argv, twin: ci/quick_backtest.sh start_inkling), runs the tier, removes the container, restarts prod, releases (class LocalDockerWindow). It must run on the GPU host (docker, permission to stop/start prod_service, model dirs ACCEPT_INKLING_MODEL / ACCEPT_INKLING_DRAFTER). The profile only declares what to assert; the references are ci/accept/references/quick-inkling.json.
